title: vandellia cordifolia
intro: Vandellia cordifolia, commonly known as "Bakauan" in some regions, is a plant species belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to treat various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Vandellia cordifolia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
